cmtab_entries.description: List of encrypted filesystem entries to manage via cryptmount. Each entry maps a device to a decrypted mount point using specified encryption parameters.

label.description: Unique symbolic name for this encrypted filesystem (used in mount commands, e.g., `cryptmount --mount <label>`).

device.description: Path to the encrypted block device (e.g., `/dev/sda2`) or encrypted file (e.g., `/home/encrypted.img`).

target.description: Name for the decrypted device-mapper target (appears as `/dev/mapper/<target>` after opening).

keyfile.description: Path to the key file, '-' to prompt interactively on mount, or 'none' for no key (plaintext).

keylength.description: Key size in bits (e.g., 128, 192, 256). Must match cipher requirements.

flags.description: List of cryptmount flags controlling behavior (e.g., 'bootwait' → wait for device at boot, 'exec' → allow executables, 'umount' → auto-unmount on stop).

items.description: Cryptmount flag. See `man cmtab` for full list.

options.description: Additional options passed to the underlying filesystem when mounted (e.g., 'utf8' for NTFS, 'uid=1000' for ownership).
